_about: Curated explanations for the BZCC console reference (scripts/extract_console_reference.py). Keys are full dotted console names, case-insensitive. `tier` is `verified` (checked in the running game or decoded from the map files and confirmed by the console) or `unverified` (community knowledge or a reasoned reading not re-tested). An optional `example` replaces the observed value when the capture caught a transient state.

scopes.sky: The per-map atmosphere. Everything here is saved in the map's `.sky` file (BZCC's editor documentation: "the SKY file contains all the information regarding atmosphere, weather, fog and effects, sun angle and time of day, sky graphics, ambient color, and visibility distance"). The `[NormalView]` fog and `[Light]` keys in the older `.trn` are no longer what the game renders; only the terrain material keys there still apply (see `terrain`). Values below were read on Europa Night (`vsreuronig`); Remnant reads fog `120 110 80`, range `300 -> 600`, visibility `600`, ambient `55 90 120`.
scopes.sun: The directional light and the sun (or moon) sprite. The sun travels a fixed east-to-west arc: `angle 6` is sunrise on the east horizon, `12` is directly overhead, `18` is sunset in the west, with `period` hours per full cycle, in real time. The `color` alpha scales the light's brightness. Verified live on Remnant.
scopes.fog: Volumetric extras layered on top of the distance fog in `sky`: up to 16 local fog volumes (ellipsoids with a density), a height (ground) fog band, and underwater fog. The stock sky templates ship three local volumes at fixed positions that most maps never move.
scopes.dome: The sky dome mesh (`name`, e.g. `miredome.fbx`), its scale and scroll, the color the dome is lit with, and an optional dome light.
scopes.stars: A layer of star sprites drawn on the dome.
scopes.sprites: Sky billboards: moons, nebulae, lens flares and god rays placed by azimuth and elevation. `select` picks the slot the other variables edit.
scopes.rain: Weather: rain streaks (`beadcount`, `beadwidth`, `speed`, `direction`) with on/off/transition periods, plus the colour the dome is tinted while it rains.
scopes.splat: Impact and droplet decals: `ground` (projectile splats), `water` (surface rings) and `windshield` (raindrops on the cockpit glass). Each sub-scope has the same shape.
scopes.chrome: The environment (reflection) map applied to shiny vehicle surfaces, named by the sky file (`dunes_night_environ.tga` on Europa Night).
scopes.terrain: Terrain material and level-of-detail tuning. The material comes from the map's `.trn` `[NormalView]` block: `DiffuseColor`, `SpecularColor`, `SpecularPower`. When the `.trn` omits `DiffuseColor` the engine uses `178 178 178`, not white (confirmed on Remnant).
scopes.vid: Video device and renderer controls, mostly legacy driver/mode listing from the DirectX 7-9 era; `vid.render` holds the live render toggles.
scopes.game: Session-level commands: load/save, pause, cheats, team colours, asset baking and threading diagnostics.
scopes.mission: Mission lifecycle: run, pause, restart, abort, save and load. `filename` prints nothing in 2.0.206; the loaded map is visible in the session log (`Loaded from file <map>.bzn`).
scopes.script: The mission script layer: the DLL or Lua the mission runs (`setdll`), cinematic recording/playback, and per-team base hull readouts the DLL exposes.
scopes.control: The command-panel bindings the HUD reads: base structures (`control.base`), the build/command menu (`control.command`), unit groups (`control.group`), satellite view, and the team list. These are display bindings refreshed by the game, not settings.
scopes.status: HUD readouts bound by the cockpit configs: hull and ammo ratios and text, and the names of the five weapon hardpoints with their shot counters.
scopes.network: Multiplayer: session creation and joining, the lobby's game-option variables (`ivarN` / `svarN`), chat, map downloads and vehicle lists. Values are not recorded here (lobby state and player names).
scopes.options: Player preferences as saved to the options file. Names and types only; values are personal.
scopes.gameprefs: Overrides for `GamePrefs.ini`; every key's own comment from that file is quoted. Values are personal.
scopes.inputbind: Key and axis bindings. Each of the 97 actions is a scope with the same shape: button actions carry `value1` / `value2` (two bindings) with `bind` / `clear`; the four axis actions (`steer`, `pitch`, `strafe`, `throttle`) add `scale`, `sign1` / `sign2` and `reverse1` / `reverse2`. Key assignments are personal and not recorded.
scopes.iface: The in-game UI layer: console display settings, screen fades, dialog control, and the interface-wide screenshot command.
scopes.console: Console file logging. With `log` on, every console line is appended to the session log (`Battlezone <date>.log` in the My Games folder) as `DIAG| console:NNN |time|tick|text` — the capture method behind this reference.
scopes.debug: Debug overlays: bounding boxes, collision shapes, player info, asset CRCs.
scopes.profile: Listed by `ls` but reports no members in 2.0.206.
scopes.multilanguage: Listed by `ls` but reports no members in 2.0.206.
scopes.iam: Internal. The single command's purpose is not documented anywhere in the install.
scopes.view: Camera views: cockpit toggle, cycling, interface visibility, occlusion test, and the `view.set` family that switches to a named view.
scopes.editor: Map editor; the shipped build exposes only the editor camera's wireframe flag here (the editor UI binds its own `editor.*` variables when active).
scopes.mesh: Mesh loading and simplification (MRM) tuning; mostly tool-time settings.
scopes.keybind: Legacy key binding commands (`dump`, `names`, `hold`, `press`); current bindings live in `inputbind`.
scopes.shell: Menu shell background and option-screen control.
scopes.scrap: Live scrap readouts bound by the HUD: current supply and storage maximum.
scopes.ai: AI debugging aids: cliff calculation, control test, plan selection, autopilot.

sky.fogcolor.text: Prints and sets the distance-fog colour. In 2.0.206 this is the colour stored first in the map's `.sky` file (`SKY1` chunk offset 0x00); `fogcolorr/g/b/a` are its channels. Remnant prints `fogColor = 120 110 80 RGB`, Europa Night `20 25 30`. Everything beyond `fogend` fades to this colour.

sky.fogcolorr.text: Red channel of the distance-fog colour (`sky.fogcolor`).

sky.fogcolorg.text: Green channel of the distance-fog colour (`sky.fogcolor`).

sky.fogcolorb.text: Blue channel of the distance-fog colour (`sky.fogcolor`).

sky.fogcolora.text: Alpha channel of the distance-fog colour; 255 on every map checked.

sky.fogrange.text: Prints `fogRange = <start> -> <end>` and sets both ends at once. Distance fog is linear: nothing is fogged nearer than `fogstart`, everything is fully `fogcolor` at `fogend`. Remnant `300 -> 600` metres, Europa Night `150 -> 500`. Players can only shorten these (GamePrefs `VisibilityMult`, `MaxFogRange`), never extend them.

sky.fogstart.text: Distance in metres where fog begins. May be negative (Aussault `-30`), which simply starts the ramp behind the camera.

sky.fogend.text: Distance in metres where fog is fully opaque. The editor warns that it must not exceed `visibilityrange`.

sky.visibilityrange.text: Far clip distance in metres: nothing beyond it is drawn at all. 600 on Remnant and Europa Night; the corpus spans 320 to 1000. Because `fogend` is at or below this, the cut is hidden inside fully fogged pixels.

sky.fogmode.text: Fog curve: `0` none, `1` exponential, `2` exponential-squared, `3` linear. Every VSR map checked reports `3`. The game says the value is saved by editing the `.trn`, not the `.sky`.

sky.fogexponentdensity.text: Density used by the exponential fog modes (`fogmode` 1 and 2). Unused under the linear mode every VSR map ships with.

sky.fogbreak.text: Position of a bend in the linear fog ramp, as a fraction between `fogstart` and `fogend`. `0.5` (the midpoint) on every map checked, which makes the ramp a plain straight line.

sky.color.text: The editor's "Sky Color" in the Sky Texture group: the tint of the dome and of the flat cloud layer (`sky.texturename`), whose alpha (`sky.colora`) is that layer's opacity. Stored in the `.sky` as a BGRA byte colour (`SKY1` offset 0x74). Europa Night `40 55 60`, Remnant `180 170 130`. It is NOT a clear colour: where no sky layer draws the game shows `fogcolor` (Europa Night's dome-off sky reads the fully fogged value between its cloud wisps up to 30 degrees).

sky.colora.text: Alpha channel of `sky.color`: the opacity of the flat cloud layer (255 on 106 of 157 VSR skies, 50-200 on the rest).

sky.ambientcolor.text: Prints and sets the scene's ambient light, the flat fill every surface receives before the sun is added. Europa Night `10 15 20` (a near-black night fill), Remnant `55 90 120`. On the flat-lit lunar maps it is `255 255 255` with a black sun.

sky.ambientcolorr.text: Red channel of the ambient light colour.

sky.ambientcolorg.text: Green channel of the ambient light colour.

sky.ambientcolorb.text: Blue channel of the ambient light colour.

sky.ambientcolora.text: Alpha of the ambient colour, acting as its intensity (255 = 1.0). Ebola, Europa and Royal Stadium use 102 (0.4); Oasis 350 (1.37).

sky.texturename.text: Cloud-layer texture scrolled across the sky (`white_clouds.tga` on most VSR maps, `toxic_clouds.tga`, `darkflat3.tga`, or empty for a bare dome).

sky.height.text: Height of the cloud layer above the camera, in metres (Europa Night and Remnant 120).

sky.tilesize.text: Repeat size of the cloud texture in metres (Europa Night 300, Remnant 500).

sky.uspeed.text: Cloud texture scroll speed along U.

sky.vspeed.text: Cloud texture scroll speed along V.

sky.uvspeed.text: Sets both cloud scroll speeds (`uspeed vspeed`) in one command.

sky.modulate.text: Blend mode of the flat cloud plane: `1` is the editor's "Add" (additive), `0` is "Blend" (alpha blend). Europa Night and Remnant store `0`.

sky.flags.text: Bit field of the sky layers the engine draws, one bit per editor toggle (`bzeditor_sky.cfg`), named the same way by the engine's own `sky.toggle` print-out (`DOME= STARS= FLAT= CLOUDS= SPRITES= SUN=`): `1` Dome, `2` Stars, `4` Flat (the `sky.texturename` cloud plane -- the legacy `.trn` `[Sky] SkyTexture / SkyHeight / SkyColor` section), `8` Clouds (the legacy `[Clouds] Count / TextureN / SizeN / HeightN` cloud billboards; `Count = 0` on every VSR map, so nothing is drawn), `16` Sprites, `32` Sun. Remnant `49` = dome + sprites + sun; Europa Night `54` = stars + flat + sprites + sun, so its template dome name is never drawn and the sky is the fog colour with stars, the full-moon sun and faint cloud wisps. Bit `64` appears on six maps and has no toggle.

sky.type.text: Sky type selector written by the editor's Sky panel (`SkyType` in the legacy `.trn`); prints `sky type = %d`. Every VSR map uses the dome type.

sky.toggle.text: Flips one `sky.flags` layer bit (the editor's Toggle Dome / Stars / Flat / Clouds / Sprites / Sun buttons write through it) and prints the six switches as `DOME=%d STARS=%d FLAT=%d CLOUDS=%d SPRITES=%d SUN=%d`.

sky.save.text: Writes the current sky settings to `<map>.sky` (`Saved <map>.sky`). Do not run this on a shipped map unless you mean to change it.

sky.load.text: Reloads `<map>.sky` from disk (`Loaded <map>.sky`). Prints nothing visible in 2.0.206 when the file is already current.

sun.angle.text: Position of the sun along its arc, in the same hour units as `period`. `6` puts it on the east horizon, `12` directly overhead, `18` on the west horizon (verified live on Remnant). Authored values: Remnant `16.0`, Europa Night `15.5`. The capture caught `18.0` because the probe left it there; the stored value is `15.5`.

sun.period.text: Length of a full day-night cycle in **real-time hours** (the game prints `sun period = %f realtime hours`). `24` on most maps, so the sun drifts about 15 degrees per hour of play; Bolt uses `1` (a full cycle every hour) and Marden Warfare `2400` (static).

sun.color.text: Prints and sets the sun light's colour as `R G B A`. The alpha is the light's intensity: Remnant `255 230 150 200` (a warm sun at 0.78), Europa Night `255 255 255 125` (white moonlight at 0.49), Know Thyself alpha 500 (1.96). Lunar, Lunix and Moonshroud use `0 0 0` and light the scene with ambient alone.

sun.colorr.text: Red channel of the sun light colour.

sun.colorg.text: Green channel of the sun light colour.

sun.colorb.text: Blue channel of the sun light colour.

sun.colora.text: Alpha of the sun colour, acting as the light's intensity (255 = 1.0).

sun.ambientcolor.text: Alias of `sky.ambientcolor` registered under the sun scope.

sun.size.text: Angular size of the sun or moon sprite in degrees (`sun size = %f degrees`); 30 on Remnant and Europa Night. The disc occupies only part of the texture, so the visible body is smaller. Unlike `sprites.size`, which is metres at `sprites.distance`.

sun.distance.text: Distance at which the sun sprite is drawn, in metres (200 on both maps checked; inside the dome radius).

sun.texturename.text: Sprite texture for the light source: `dunesun.tga` by day, `dunemoonfull.tga` on Europa Night and the other night maps, so the moon is literally the sun.

fog.toggle.text: Shows or hides the local fog volumes (the editor's "Show/Hide Local Fog" button).

fog.select.text: Index of the local fog volume (0-15) that `position`, `radius`, `density` and `localcolor` edit.

fog.new.text: Deprecated: the game answers `Command 'fog.new' is depreciated. Please select a slot using 'fog.select [index]'`.

fog.position.text: Centre of the selected local fog volume (`x y z`, world metres); the stock dunes template places three volumes at (350, 8, -267), (18, 6, -258) and (-367, 6, -131).

fog.positionx.text: X of the selected local fog volume's centre.

fog.positiony.text: Y (height) of the selected local fog volume's centre.

fog.positionz.text: Z of the selected local fog volume's centre.

fog.radius.text: Half-extents of the selected volume (`x y z`); the template volumes are 100 x 30 x 100 metres.

fog.radiusx.text: X half-extent of the selected local fog volume.

fog.radiusy.text: Y half-extent (height) of the selected local fog volume.

fog.radiusz.text: Z half-extent of the selected local fog volume.

fog.density.text: Density of the selected local fog volume; `-1` marks an unused slot in the `.sky` file.

fog.localcolor.text: Colour of the selected local fog volume (`R G B`); `-1 -1 -1` means use the global fog colour.

fog.userposition.text: Moves the selected volume to the player's position (editor convenience).

fog.cameraposition.text: Moves the selected volume to the camera position (the editor's "Snap to Camera Position" button).

fog.current.text: Prints the selected local fog volume's settings.

fog.height.text: Sets the height (ground) fog band in one command; see `heightstart`, `heightend`, `heightdensity`.

fog.heightstart.text: World height where the ground fog band begins. 0 with `heightdensity` 0 means no ground fog (Remnant, Europa Night); Twin Peaks and DuneNight use -50 to 200.

fog.heightend.text: World height where the ground fog band ends.

fog.heightdensity.text: Density of the ground fog band; `0` or `-1` disables it.

fog.heightcurve.text: Shape of the density falloff across the ground fog band (editor "Curve" slider).

fog.heightmindist.text: Camera distance at which ground fog starts to apply.

fog.heightmaxdist.text: Camera distance at which ground fog reaches full density (150 on the maps checked).

fog.uspeed.text: Scroll speed of the local-fog volume texture along U.

fog.vspeed.text: Scroll speed of the local-fog volume texture along V.

fog.wspeed.text: Scroll speed of the local-fog volume texture along W (the 3D fog texture's third axis).

fog.water.enable.text: Turns underwater fog on (`1`) or off (`0`); the game prints `underwater fog is %d`.

fog.water.top.text: Depth below the surface where the top fog colour applies (`top fog end = %fm`).

fog.water.bottom.text: Depth where the bottom fog colour is reached (`bottom fog end = %fm`).

fog.water.break.text: Fraction between the top and bottom depths where the two colours cross over.

fog.water.depth.text: Visibility depth of the underwater fog.

fog.water.color.text: Sets the underwater fog colours; see the `topcolor*` and `bottomcolor*` channels.

dome.name.text: Dome mesh file (`miredome.fbx` on 46 VSR maps, `dunedome` 25, `plutodome` 15, `banedome` 14, `marsdome` 10, `rendsky.xsi` 8, `darkdome` 7, a few others), baked by the game to `.msh`. It is only drawn when `sky.flags` has the Dome bit (1): Europa Night names `miredome.fbx` but has the bit off, so its sky is stars and faint cloud wisps over the fog colour.

dome.radius.text: Dome radius in metres (300 on Europa Night, 200 on Remnant). Stored in the `.sky` `DOME` chunk.

dome.ambient.text: Colour the dome mesh is lit with (`R G B`), independent of the scene lights; `100 60 20` in the stock dunes template.

dome.ambientr.text: Red channel of the dome's lighting colour.

dome.ambientg.text: Green channel of the dome's lighting colour.

dome.ambientb.text: Blue channel of the dome's lighting colour.

dome.uv.text: Sets the dome texture offset (`u v`).

dome.uvspeed.text: Sets the dome texture scroll speed (`uspeed vspeed`).

dome.type.text: Dome type selector: the editor's "Dome" (0, 74 VSR maps) or "Planet" (1, 64 maps; Remnant and Europa Night); four maps store 2. No visible difference between 0 and 1 has been established.

dome.height.text: Vertical offset of the dome mesh in metres (editor "Dome Height"); 0 on Europa Night and Remnant, 20-100 on most other VSR maps, -10 on the lunar maps.

dome.distance.text: Draw distance of the dome (editor "Distance"); equals the radius on the maps checked.

dome.azim.text: Rotation of the dome mesh about the vertical axis, in degrees.

dome.light.select.text: Index of the dome light being edited.

dome.light.position.text: Sets the dome light's direction as azimuth and elevation (the editor's Azim / Elev sliders).

dome.light.azim.text: Azimuth of the dome light in degrees (90 in the stock template).

dome.light.elev.text: Elevation of the dome light in degrees (35 in the stock template).

dome.light.dist.text: Distance of the dome light from the camera.

stars.count.text: Number of star sprites drawn when `sky.flags` has the Stars bit (2); 128 on Europa Night and most maps, 64 or 84 on others. Positions are not stored in the `.sky`; the engine scatters them at load.

stars.size.text: Size of each star sprite in metres at `stars.distance` (0.2 on Europa Night, 1.0 in the stock template): well under a pixel, so the stars draw as the smallest points the renderer allows.

stars.distance.text: Distance at which the stars are drawn, in metres (200 on Europa Night, 100 in the template).

stars.texture.text: Star sprite texture (`lightflare.tga` on 141 of 142 VSR maps, `plasma.dds` on one).

stars.color.text: Sets the star tint (`R G B A`); white everywhere, alpha 255 on most maps (100 on a few).

stars.azimspeed.text: Starfield rotation speed about the vertical axis (0 on all but four maps, which store 1000).

stars.elevspeed.text: Starfield drift speed in elevation (0 on all but four maps).

stars.height.text: Vertical offset of the starfield layer in metres (0 on most maps, 10-100 on 21).

stars.modulate.text: Blend mode of the star sprites: `1` is the editor's "Add", `0` "Blend" (Europa Night 1).

sprites.select.text: Index of the sky sprite being edited; the other `sprites.*` variables read and write that slot.

sprites.size.text: Size of the selected sprite in metres at `sprites.distance` (100 on every VSR map), so the quad spans `2 atan(size / 200)`: Remnant's large crescent moon (40) covers 22.6 degrees, its small companion (10) 5.7. `0` hides the slot; the stock template carries 44 slots, most of them 0.

sprites.distance.text: Distance of the sprite shell in metres (100 on every VSR map; the `.sky` SPRT header). A sprite's `size` is metres at this distance.

sprites.modulate.text: Blend mode of the selected sprite: `1` is the editor's "Add" -- additive, so a moon texture's black body adds nothing and only the lit crescent shows (Remnant's crescent adds about `+100 +85 +80` to the dome in the game, well under a full additive draw); `0` "Blend" -- an alpha disc (Earth on the lunar maps).

sprites.color.text: Sets the selected sprite's tint (`R G B A`). Remnant's moon is `255 220 180 255`; the `.sky` stores the bytes as B,G,R,A.

sprites.colora.text: Alpha of the selected sprite's tint (its opacity): 255 on both Remnant moons, 100 on the template's hidden godlight slot.

sprites.azim.text: Compass direction of the selected sprite in degrees; `0` is north (the big moon on Remnant sits dead ahead when facing north), positive clockwise.

sprites.elev.text: Elevation of the selected sprite above the horizon in degrees.

sprites.roll.text: Roll of the selected sprite about its view axis in degrees.

sprites.height.text: Vertical offset of the sprite shell in metres (0 on every VSR map; the `.sky` SPRT header).

rain.enable.text: Rain on (`1`) or off (`0`); the session log reports `Rain DISABLED` or `ENABLED` when the sky loads.

rain.toggle.text: Toggles rain for the session without saving.

rain.onperiod.text: Seconds the rain stays on (`on period=%g (0 is forever)`).

rain.offperiod.text: Seconds the rain stays off (`off period=%g (0 is forever)`).

rain.tranperiod.text: Seconds to fade between on and off (`transition period=%g (0 is instant change)`).

rain.domecolor.text: Colour the dome is tinted while raining (`R G B A`).

rain.count.text: Sets the number of rain streaks.

rain.size.text: Sets the rain streak size (`beadwidth beadheight`).

rain.color.text: Sets the rain streak colour (`R G B A`).

splat.toggle.text: Splat decals on (`1`) or off (`0`); the session log reports `Splat ENABLED` when the sky loads.

splat.blocksize.text: Size in metres of the spatial blocks the splats are managed in.

chrome.texture.text: Environment-map texture for reflective surfaces, from the `.sky` `ENV_` chunk (`dunes_night_environ.tga` on Europa Night, `dunes_day_environ.tga` on Remnant).

chrome.color.text: Tint applied to the environment map (`R G B A`); `255 255 255 255` on every map checked (`ENVC` chunk).

terrain.diffusecolor.text: Prints and sets the terrain material's diffuse colour (`terrain diffuse color = R G B A RGBA`). Comes from `[NormalView] DiffuseColor` in the map's `.trn`; when the key is absent the engine uses `178 178 178 255` (Remnant), so terrain is about 30% darker than its textures. Europa Night sets `240 240 240`.

terrain.specularcolor.text: Terrain material specular colour from `[NormalView] SpecularColor`; `255 255 255 255` when the `.trn` omits it (Remnant), `240 240 240` on Europa Night.

terrain.specularpower.text: Terrain specular exponent from `[NormalView] SpecularPower` (Europa Night `1024`, a very tight highlight).

terrain.emissivecolor.text: Terrain material emissive colour (`[NormalView] EmissiveColor`); black on every map checked.

terrain.recomputevalues.text: Recomputes the terrain's derived values (normals, LOD error limits) after a change.

terrain.heighterrorlimit0.text: Height error allowed by terrain level-of-detail at detail level 0 (low); larger values simplify more aggressively.

terrain.heighterrorlimit1.text: Height error allowed by terrain level-of-detail at detail level 1 (medium).

terrain.heighterrorlimit2.text: Height error allowed by terrain level-of-detail at detail level 2 (high).

terrain.colorerrorlimit0.text: Colour error allowed by terrain simplification at detail level 0.

terrain.colorerrorlimit1.text: Colour error allowed by terrain simplification at detail level 1.

terrain.colorerrorlimit2.text: Colour error allowed by terrain simplification at detail level 2.

terrain.upsamplemode.text: How the terrain texture layers are upsampled (`1` on the maps checked).

terrain.outsidereverbindex.text: Audio reverb preset used while outdoors.

terrain.buildingreverbindex.text: Audio reverb preset used inside buildings.

vid.render.lighting.text: Toggles scene lighting in the renderer.

vid.render.dome.text: Toggles drawing of the sky dome.

vid.render.terrainreduce.text: Toggles terrain mesh reduction (level of detail).

vid.fullscreen.text: Switches between full-screen and windowed modes.

vid.listmodes.text: Lists the display modes offered by the current adapter.

console.log.text: Toggles console file logging; prints `Console file logging is now ON` / `OFF`. While on, every console line is appended to the session log as `DIAG| console:NNN |time|tick|text`. In 2.0.206 the log lives in `My Games\Battlezone Combat Commander\Battlezone <date>.log`.

console.dump.text: Dumps console state; with file logging on, the output lands in the session log.

sys.ver.text: Prints the game version (2.0.206.10 in this capture).

sys.uptime.text: Prints how long the game has been running.

sys.runcode.text: Prints or switches the current run code (shell, mission, editor).

debug.collisions.text: Draws collision shapes; GamePrefs `MaxCollisionDrawDistance` limits how far from the camera they are drawn.

debug.assetcrcs.text: Prints asset checksums (the values compared between players in multiplayer).

mission.filename.text: The current mission's file name variable. Prints an empty value in 2.0.206 during play; the loaded map is recorded in the session log as `Loaded from file <map>.bzn` and `Reading Sky File <map>.SKY`.

mission.restart.text: Restarts the current mission from the beginning.

mission.abort.text: Abandons the current mission and returns to the shell.

mission.save.text: Saves the game (`%s.sav`); the game warns if a save would exceed its limits.

mission.reset.text: Resets the mission; the engine logs `Switching to CLEANUP, mission.reset used in mission`.

game.cheat.text: Enters a cheat code (the classic BZ2 codes, e.g. `bzbody`, `bzfree`, `bztnt`, `bzradar`); single-player only.

game.teamcolors.text: Prints or sets the team colours.

game.setgameprefscolors.text: Applies the team colours from GamePrefs.

game.setservercolors.text: Applies the team colours sent by the server.

game.bakeassets.text: Bakes source assets (`.xsi` / `.fbx` / `.tga`) into the `baked` formats (`.msh` / `.dds`) the game loads.

game.bakeshaders.text: Compiles the HLSL shaders to the `baked/shaders/*.fxc` files.

game.baketextures.text: Converts source textures to the baked `.dds` files.

game.tps.text: Prints or sets the simulation turns per second.

game.histogram.text: Toggles the multiplayer network histogram overlay (positioned by GamePrefs `Play_HistogramPosX/Y`).

game.playsound.text: Plays a sound file by name.

game.binarysave.text: Save games in binary (`1`) rather than text (`0`).

game.debugaip.text: Toggles AI plan (AIP) debugging; `aipdebugteam` selects the team.

game.shellmap.text: Loads a map as the shell (menu) background.

game.worldcount.text: Prints the number of simulation worlds.

script.setdll.text: The mission DLL in use (`strategy02.dll` on a VSR Strategy map; VSR maps also look for `<map>.lua` and log `No Lua script` when absent).

script.string.text: Free-form string the mission script can read.

script.mission.state.text: Mission state counter exposed by the script layer.

script.dll.base1hull.text: Hull fraction of team 1's base as reported by the mission DLL (and `base2hull` ... `base9hull` for the other teams).

script.record.name.text: Name of the cinematic recording being written or played.

view.cycle.text: Cycles through the available camera views (the `view_cycle` input action).

view.set.chase.text: Switches to the third-person chase camera.

view.set.satellite.text: Switches to the satellite (top-down command) view.

view.set.freeeye.text: Switches to the free-flying eye camera.

view.set.nopause.text: Camera view used while the game is in its no-pause state.

iface.screenshot.text: Takes a screenshot into the `screenshots` folder under My Games.

iface.consolelines.text: Number of console lines kept visible on the HUD (5).

iface.consolemsgtime.text: How long a console message stays on screen, in milliseconds (5000).

iface.drawiface.text: Draws the interface (`1`) or hides it (`0`).

iface.listclasses.text: Lists the registered interface control classes.

iface.setnativeres.text: Sets the interface's native design resolution.

iface.shellexpandfont.text: Scales shell fonts with the resolution.

options.graphics.fog.text: Player fog toggle. Turning it off removes distance fog; it cannot extend the map's `sky.fogrange` or `visibilityrange` (see GamePrefs `VisibilityMult`).

options.graphics.shadows.text: Shadow quality (`ShadowOff` / `ShadowLow` / `ShadowMed` / `ShadowHigh`). The lit DX11 shaders (flag `z`, `BZ_WANT_SHADOW`) sample four cascaded maps (t28-t31), pick one by view depth with no blend, and multiply that factor into the sun only.

options.graphics.windowed.text: Run in a window (`1`) or full screen (`0`).

network.session.ivarN.text: The lobby's integer game-option slots (`ivar0` … `ivar383`). Mission DLLs read them (`GetVarItemInt`) for settings such as starting scrap, time limit, kill limit and the VSR recycler variant; the lobby's option screens write them. Values are session state and are not recorded here.

network.session.svarN.text: The lobby's string game-option slots (`svar0` … `svar159`): map and mission names, team names, and mod-defined text options read by the mission DLL (`GetVarItemStr`). VSR maps expose their team names through two of these.

network.session.civarN.text: Client-side integer option slots mirrored from the host's `ivar` set.

network.session.csvarN.text: Client-side string option slots mirrored from the host's `svar` set.

network.mpvehicles.entryN.text: The vehicle choices offered in the multiplayer lobby, one display string per slot.

network.stratstarting.entryN.text: Starting-vehicle choices offered in a Strategy lobby, one display string per slot.

network.recylistN.text: Recycler variant list entries shown in the lobby (one per slot).

network.vehiclelistN.text: Vehicle list entries shown in the lobby (one per slot).

network.startingvehiclesN.text: Starting-vehicle list entries shown in the lobby (one per slot).

options.instant.intN.text: Integer settings of the Instant Action setup screen, one per option slot.

options.instant.boolN.text: Boolean settings of the Instant Action setup screen, one per option slot.

options.instant.floatN.text: Floating-point settings of the Instant Action setup screen, one per option slot.

options.instant.stringN.text: String settings of the Instant Action setup screen, one per option slot.

control.command.hullN.text: Hull cost readout of command-menu slot N, bound by the command panel.

control.command.ammoN.text: Ammo cost readout of command-menu slot N, bound by the command panel.

control.base.healthN.text: Health readout of base-structure slot N, bound by the base panel (`healthRatioN` is the 0-1 fraction).

control.base.healthRatioN.text: Health fraction (0-1) of base-structure slot N.

control.group.selectN.text: Whether unit group N is selected, bound by the group panel.

control.group.buildN.text: Build progress readout for unit group N.

control.team.selectN.text: Whether team slot N is selected in the team panel.

control.team.healthN.text: Health readout of the unit in team slot N (`healthRatioN` is the fraction).

control.team.ammoN.text: Ammo readout of the unit in team slot N (`ammoRatioN` is the fraction).

control.team.healthRatioN.text: Health fraction (0-1) of the unit in team slot N.

control.team.ammoRatioN.text: Ammo fraction (0-1) of the unit in team slot N.

control.team.nameN.text: Name of the unit in team slot N.

network.stats.teamNplayer.text: Player name shown in the stats screen for team slot N.

network.session.create.text: Hosts a new multiplayer session with the current lobby settings.

network.session.join.text: Joins the selected session from the list.

network.session.joinip.text: Joins the session at the address in `joinipstr`.

network.session.showteamnames.text: Shows the map's team names in the lobby.

network.session.switchcommandrole.text: Switches the local player between commander and thug roles in a Strategy lobby.

network.session.maxping.text: Highest ping a joining player may have.

network.session.lanonly.text: Restrict the session to the local network.

network.session.syncjoinwaitseconds.text: Seconds a late joiner waits for the world sync.

network.mapfilterstring.text: Text filter applied to the map list in the lobby.

network.downloadmap.text: Downloads the session's map from the Steam Workshop when the client lacks it.

inputbind.steer.scale.text: Axis sensitivity multiplier for the steer axis (5 by default).

inputbind.steer.sign1.text: Direction (`+` or `-`) applied to the first binding of the axis.

inputbind.steer.value1.text: First input bound to the axis (`MouseX` for steer by default).

inputbind.steer.value2.text: Second input bound to the axis (empty when unused).

inputbind.steer.reverse1.text: Flips the direction of the first axis binding.

inputbind.steer.reverse2.text: Flips the direction of the second axis binding.

inputbind.steer.bind.text: Waits for the next input and binds it to this action.

inputbind.weapon_fire.value1.text: First input bound to fire (`Mouse1` by default).

inputbind.weapon_fire.bind.text: Waits for the next input and binds it to this action.

status.hull.ratio.text: Hull fraction (0-1) of the player's vehicle, bound by the cockpit HUD.

status.hull.text.text: Hull value as displayed (`100` at full health).

status.ammo.ratio.text: Ammo fraction (0-1) of the player's vehicle.

status.ammo.text.text: Ammo value as displayed (`600` for a full Tank).

status.weapon1.name.text: Name of the weapon on hardpoint 1 (`Minigun` on the Europa Night capture); `weapon2` ... `weapon5` are the other hardpoints.

status.weapon1.shot.count.text: Shot counter for hardpoint 1's weapon (`weapon2` ... `weapon5` likewise).

scrap.supply.text: The player's team's current scrap (0 on an empty map).

scrap.max.text: The team's scrap storage cap (40 per recycler plus 20 per pool, as the economy telemetry confirms).

control.command.item0.trigger.text: Fires command-menu slot 0 (`item1` ... `item9` likewise); the HUD's command panel binds these.

control.satellite.player.text: Centres satellite view on the player.

control.satellite.recycler.text: Centres satellite view on the recycler.

editor.camera.wireframe.text: Draws the editor view in wireframe.

mesh.teamcolor.text: Applies a team colour to the loaded mesh preview.
